mechanical_capacity_vs_action.finding: Capacity restoration is reliable but not sufficient for useful action.
evidence: Minimum demotion preserved the historical decision and absorbed the blocked result in 2/2 cells.
Recurrent oldest-first demotion resolved 17 post-predecessor pressure events and recovered 41,339 cumulative prompt tokens across 24 calls, yet produced zero mutations or submissions.
Fresh exact construction reentry produced one substantive mutation in two seeds, after which effect delivery again hit capacity.

recoverability_vs_co_residency.finding: Exact recoverability is a strong safety substrate but does not create a stable semantic working set.
evidence: Aggressive recency demotion caused demoted-object access in 2/2 first decisions.
The recurrent horizon produced late repeated exact recovery without candidate progress.
Recurrent exact-state recomposition crossed both observation and effect updates but still produced resident-object rerequests.

semantic_production_vs_avoided_recovery.finding: The measured source digest was behaviorally active but economically complementary to exact recovery.
evidence: A 218-token payload cost 720 resident prompt tokens and 7,121 production tokens.
The actor reopened a related audit, then the original source, with no artifact change.

fresh_reentry_vs_transcript.finding: Fresh current-world reentry is configuration-dependent rather than globally superior.
evidence: Research phases B+C: fresh-world used 131,046 tokens versus 164,389 for transcript, while both phases passed; fresh-world used 26 calls versus 15.
Code phases B+C: fresh-world used 309,833 tokens and passed 0/2; transcript used 227,320 tokens, passed phase B, and ended phase C in a protocol error.
Task-authored bounded phases can preserve continuity, but navigation cost and artifact quality vary by domain and phase.

exact_verification_vs_model_review.finding: Exact complete audits strongly activate repair, while model-authored review or control state can fail at uptake or readiness discrimination.
evidence: Complete audit improved all 3/3 repair pairs by six total rubric cases, at 82,231 aggregate tokens versus 51,100 for narrow audit and about four times aggregate model duration.
A binary assessor correctly identified U004 as unsupported, but the actor finalized the unchanged 11/12 artifact, exactly like receipt-only control.
The H05 progress package displaced a reread with submission but closed an unchanged 10/12 strong-partial candidate.

behavior_change_vs_utility.finding: Behavioral salience and trajectory utility are empirically separable.
evidence: Digest treatment redirected demand without avoiding raw recovery.
Progress treatment reduced acquisition but caused false closure.
Complete verification produced real repair gains but remained costly and incomplete in one of three cells.

system_conclusions: Host-owned pressure detection, response reserve, exact custody, and mechanical relief are the best-supported substrate.
Static host-selected exact layouts do not solve semantic continuity or working-set stability on the large-world trajectory.
Semantic assets should be treated as state-conditional investments whose carrier, production, induced-demand, uptake, and quality costs are measured.
Closure/readiness operations require independently frozen candidate-bound evaluation; control-relative text is high leverage and high risk.
Fresh bounded phases are already established as feasible; the open issue is trigger and integration policy, not whether transcript-free reentry can ever work.

genuinely_unresolved_cells.cell: host-triggered dedicated workspace-maintenance mode with protected control headroom
genuinely_unresolved_cells.why_unresolved: Passive OPEN/PIN/RELEASE never produced a management action, while older reserved handoff proved reachability but not selective ongoing residency quality.
genuinely_unresolved_cells.required_contrast: At one authentic pending-result pressure boundary, compare the incumbent mechanical minimum-necessary policy with a separate maintenance-only selection call whose prompt is guaranteed to fit and whose selected exact workspace is then used by the ordinary actor.

genuinely_unresolved_cells.cell: bounded semantic continuity across recurrent recomposition outside closure
genuinely_unresolved_cells.why_unresolved: Progress-state utility was tested only at a defect-bearing closure boundary and caused premature submission; frontier expression never reached an actor.
genuinely_unresolved_cells.required_contrast: Use plain bounded text at a construction or repair boundary where readiness is independently frozen and submission is not the immediate desired action.

genuinely_unresolved_cells.why_unresolved: Task-authored phase reentry worked, but no evidence supports automatic phase selection or arbitrary integration quality.
genuinely_unresolved_cells.required_contrast: A mechanically triggered phase boundary with an exact current-world incumbent and a predeclared cross-part integration rubric.

routing.selected_next_design: offline eligibility and preflight for dedicated workspace-maintenance mode
routing.reason: It is the highest-priority cell not already answered by passive management, reserved handoff, exact-layout, digest, progress, verification, or phase-reentry evidence.
routing.stop_condition: If no donor boundary can support a maintenance-only call plus a matched ordinary continuation without adding semantic state, record ineligibility and do not improvise a new world.

claim_limit: This is a descriptive integration of heterogeneous episodes. It does not pool task scores, estimate a universal policy effect, or promote a context manager.
